Reel-In Save.name: Reel-In Save
Reel-In Save.description: The user fires a line at a person in danger anywhere within a street's width and hauls them to the user's side in an instant: out from under a falling beam, out of a car's path, off a ledge or out of a burning doorway. An attack aimed at them misses, and they land on their feet beside the user, unhurt by the pull. Strain: moderate.
